title: The Compilability Thresholds of 2-CNF to OBDD
summary: We prove the existence of two thresholds regarding the compilability of random 2-CNF formulas to OBDDs. The formulas are drawn from $\mathcal{F}_2(n,δn)$, the uniform distribution over all 2-CNFs with $δn$ clauses and $n$ variables, with $δ\geq 0$ a constant. We show that, with high probability, the random 2-CNF admits OBDDs of size polynomial in $n$ if $0 \leq δ 1$. On the other hand, for $1/2 < δ< 1$, with high probability, the random $2$-CNF admits only OBDDs of size exponential in $n$.
